name: paint-gradient-range
_comment: CSS Images 3 two-position color stops. Reading only the last length of '#e23b3b 0% 50%, #2f6fed 50% 100%' blends the bottom half instead of a hard edge at 50%. The flat bands are wide enough that a blend fails the pixel compare. pixel_tolerance 1 absorbs the same boundary dither as paint-gradient.
